subject: MAP: Production ramp — Dedicated/Private lead times & GPU pool sizing
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@heliotrope.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP and lead-time questions for Dedicated/Private

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to build a short mutual action plan (MAP) so our infra and procurement teams can line up on committed capacity and timing. Two initial asks from our side:

1) For a Private (VPC) deployment with strict data residency, what are realistic lead times for availability (procurement + infra + provisioning) if we commit to a 3-month Dedicated pool?

2) For sizing to support peak inference for our beta (approx 2M tokens/day, 99th pct latency 250ms), what GPU pool/config do you recommend, and what flexibility is there to burst?

Attached: a short questionnaire and a draft timeline from our procurement team. Can we get a MAP draft by Thursday?

Sincerely,
Sarah Lin
Head of Platform
Heliotrope AI

Attachments: Helio_MAP_questions.pdf (1 page PDF)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@heliotrope.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@heliotrope.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP and lead-time questions for Dedicated/Private

Sarah —

Thanks — appreciate the clear asks. High-level answers inline and then a proposed MAP (attached).

Quick answers:
- Lead time: Private VPC + on-prem options typically 6-10 weeks from signed commitment to customer-ready (includes contract, PO, procurement of reserved capacity, and network setup).
- Sizing: For 2M tokens/day with 250ms 99th pct, we recommend starting with a 6-GPU pool (A100-equivalent or T4+quantization profile depending on model family), with autoscale + burst to spare 2 GPUs. This gives headroom for peak bursts while keeping baseline costs predictable.

I'll loop Karthik for the detailed procurement milestones and Marissa for the commercial cadence (credits, timing of invoice, DocuSign). Please see attached MAP_v1.xlsx — it's a one-page mutual action plan with milestone dates shaded.

Can you confirm: target production date (your desired go-live) and whether the data residency requires on-prem vs VPC in us-east?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah@heliotrope.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP and lead-time questions for Dedicated/Private

Adding sizing and procurement detail from infra side —

Evelyn / Sarah / Marissa,

Notes:
- Lead-time breakdown (estimate):
  * Contract & PO finalization: 1-2 weeks (engineering acceptance + legal turnaround common gating items)
  * Reserved capacity allocation + provisioning: 3-5 weeks (hardware availability dependent; committed pools prioritized)
  * VPC network setup & validation: 1 week
  * Smoke tests + model onboarding: 1 week
  => Total: 6-9 weeks typical; allow up to 12 weeks in constrained regions or for on-prem appliances.

- GPU pool sizing rationale:
  * 6 x 80GB-class GPUs (or 12 x 40GB-class split with model sharding) for baseline to meet 99th-percentile latency; this assumes medium-sized decoder model (7-13B).
  * If Helio plans to use 70B+ model family, sizing steps up to 12 x 80GB-class or quantized 8-bit deployments with additional inference replicas.
  * Burst plan: automatic policy to add 2-3 transient GPUs from a burst pool for short intervals; billing shows burst separately.

- Operational risks: procurement lead time variability; custom network security reviews; customer-side model packaging delays.

I'll attach a short procurement checklist for Heliotrope's infra team.

— Karthik
Head of Dedicated Deployments — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: procurement_timeline_draft.pdf (1 page)

Thanks team — commercial notes and next steps.

Sarah: to keep the MAP short and actionable, propose these milestone commitments:
- Day 0: Signed SOW & PO (Redwood issues invoice within 24h of PO receipt)
- Week 1: Contract countersigned / security questionnaire completed (SOC2 evidence shared)
- Week 2–4: Reserved capacity procurement and initial provisioning (hardware allocation)
- Week 5: Network & VPC set up; customer validation window opens
- Week 6: Model onboarding + smoke test; go/no-go for production ramp

Commercial levers: we can offer a 6-week credit buffer for onboarding (one-time credit applied to first invoice) if Helio commits to a 3-month reserved term and a brief technical PO by COB next Tuesday. Also can offer a 10% burst credit for the first month.

Please confirm: preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) and whether a standard Redwood SLA is acceptable or you need enterprise SLA addendum.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
